name: Bountiful Sunlight
location: Pisaca - Little Sister
acquisition: Pisaca - Little Sister
description: Gradually restores HP over time for a short duration to you and nearby allies. Must be part of the Princess's Guard to use.

name: Darkmoon Blade
location: Covenant: Darkmoon Offer 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal to Gwyndolin to get to Rank 1 in order to obtain it
acquisition: Covenant: Darkmoon Offer 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal to Gwyndolin to get to Rank 1 in order to obtain it
description: Boosts right hand weapon with rays of Darkmoon. Adds 1.8x your talisman's Magic Adjustment value as Magic Damage at Covenant Rank 0. Scaling increases by 0.1x for each rank to a maximum of 2.1x at Covenant Rank 3. • Must be member of Darkmoon covenant to use.

name: Emit Force
location: After you clear Anor Londo, Siegmeyer of Catarina will appear at Firelink Shrine. When you talk to him he will ask if you opened the gates to Sen's Fortress. Say "yes" and you will receive the miracle.
acquisition: After you clear Anor Londo, Siegmeyer of Catarina will appear at Firelink Shrine. When you talk to him he will ask if you opened the gates to Sen's Fortress. Say "yes" and you will receive the miracle.
description: Shoots a large ball of force energy to explode on the target causing damage to the target and close surrounding enemies. Can deflect sorceries.

name: Escape Death
location: Unobtainable by normal means; the miracle lacks an icon when viewed on the Attune Magic page or in the player's spell slots, so the game developers likely did not finish it.
acquisition: Unobtainable by normal means; the miracle lacks an icon when viewed on the Attune Magic page or in the player's spell slots, so the game developers likely did not finish it.
description: Escape Death is a self-buff that prevents the user from losing souls and humanity after death. The miracle will not work if the user has two other self-buffs active (i.e. having both the Green Blossom stamina regen effect and the Transient Curse's effect will prevent the use of this miracle). Upon death, the message "Magic Revived" appears in green lettering identical to the "Ring Revival" message produced when a player dies with a Ring of Sacrifice equipped.

name: Force
location: Petrus of Thorolund 4,000 Souls Reah of Thorolund 1,000 Souls
acquisition: Petrus of Thorolund 4,000 Souls Reah of Thorolund 1,000 Souls
description: AoE effect that does no damage but knocks back most surrounding enemies Must be very close to cause knockdown Can deflect sorceries such as Homing Soulmass.

location: Covenant: Gravelord Servant Requires rank +1 in the covenant.
acquisition: Covenant: Gravelord Servant Requires rank +1 in the covenant.
description: Upgraded version of Gravelord Sword Dance miracle. Area of effect is expanded and increased damage.

name: Gravelord Sword Dance
location: Covenant: Gravelord Servant Note: Each casting costs 20 uses
acquisition: Covenant: Gravelord Servant Note: Each casting costs 20 uses
description: AoE miracle similar to Gravelord Nito's "scream sword" attack. Several swords will pierce the ground impaling enemies in the area. Miracle is very effective when used in close quarters such as hallways or bridges as several swords may impale the same enemy.

name: Great Heal
location: Reah of Thorolund 10,000 Souls
acquisition: Reah of Thorolund 10,000 Souls

description: Cut down version of Great Heal. Heals large amount of HP to the caster. (NOTE: This spell does not affect allies as the erroneous load screen info would have you believe.)

acquisition: Covenant: Warrior of Sunlight Requires rank 1 in the covenant.

name: Karmic Justice
location: Oswald of Carim 40,000 Souls
acquisition: Oswald of Carim 40,000 Souls
description: Karmic Justice is a self-buff that lasts for 1 minute. If the player takes successive hits in PHYSICAL damage (meaning melee and non-magical), the spell explodes, dealing massive damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them all down. A very effective miracle for players who wear cloth armor with no poise. If they get stunlocked by a combo, this spell can save you from certain death.

name: Lightning Spear
location: Covenant: Warrior of Sunlight
acquisition: Covenant: Warrior of Sunlight
description: A powerful spear of light that inflicts lightning damage. Scales with faith. Can be thrown into bodies of water to cause AoE. (Puddles, lakes,etc.)

name: Tranquil Walk of Peace
location: Catacombs - From the second bonfire, go across the bridge to the spiral tower with two skeletons. There's a breakable wall with a big skeleton behind it. Go through a hole on the right side of the room and follow it up until you get to a necromancer. There's an easily missable ladder and the miracle is at the top..
